entities.name: Grażyna Gęsicka
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Grażyna Gęsicka was a Polish sociologist and politician and a former (2006–2007) minister of Regional Development in Marcinkiewicz's and Jarosław Kaczyński's government. In 2007 she was elected to the Sejm. From 2009 until her death she was the leader of Law and Justice parliamentary caucus.
